_notice: NEVER USED. Example only: copy to config.json after the R04 installer is installed. Values in <angle brackets> are placeholders. productName must equal the DisplayName of the installer's Windows uninstall entry; installedExe must lie under its InstallLocation. provider.kind must be real and provider.id one of openai-compatible, claude-code, codex (the app's default Provider). provider.version: the CLI version, or the model name for openai-compatible.
